description: Part-load efficiency + strong ambient temperature sensitivity + altitude derating

unit.name: Generic 200 kWe Recuperated Micro Gas Turbine (Capstone C200-class)
unit.source: Capstone C200 product data sheet; US EPA CHP Catalog (2017) Section 5: Microturbines; ISO 2314:2009

P_el_rated_kw.note: ISO-rated output at 15 degC, 101.325 kPa, sea level

eta_el_rated.note: Net electrical efficiency at full load (LHV, ISO conditions)

LHV_gas_mjkg.note: Lower heating value of natural gas

rho_gas_kgm3.note: Density of natural gas at STP

f_amb_coeff.note: Ambient temperature efficiency sensitivity (~0.01/K, 1%/K); microturbines are highly sensitive because small compressor has less pressure ratio margin

altitude_derating_pct_per_100m.note: Power derating per 100m altitude (air density effect, slightly higher than reciprocating engines due to no turbocharger compensation)
